dedupe_keys.name: idra cabauw polarimetric weather radar observations

description: TU Delft provides the IDRA weather-radar archive from the Cabauw Experimental Site for Atmospheric Research in the Netherlands. The polarimetric radar was installed on the 213 metre meteorological tower in August 2007 to observe rainfall, drizzle, low clouds and fog. Variables include reflectivity, mean Doppler velocity, spectrum width and several polarimetric parameters. The 4TU.ResearchData landing page describes a growing time series, refreshed every few months, and links to an OPeNDAP catalogue of NetCDF files. The deposit states CC0 and free availability. These observations can support rainfall retrieval, calibrate precipitation inputs and test urban drainage or catchment flood simulations. The elevated site reduces ground clutter and permits comparison with other CESAR observations. Exact archive end dates, sampling intervals and retrieval uncertainty require the individual series documentation. Radar measurements must be converted and quality checked before treating them as ground-level rainfall. No observation files were downloaded or processed.
